name: Beijing Capital International Airport
notes: Tried 28 Oct 2026: China eAIP (www.eaipchina.cn, www.aischina.com) - fetch blocked (permission not granted in time); only unofficial mirrors of old (2019) eAIP editions were found by search, which may not be used. Operator site www.bcia.com.cn read: the 'about us' page (gsjj.html) says only that the airport has three terminals and three runways, with no lengths, hours, customs or business-aviation details, so nothing was recorded; the corporate page (gsjssy.html) refused automated reading (robots) and en.bcia.com.cn was blocked. CAAC AIP AD 2 for this airport should be obtained (e.g. via a registered eAIP China account) and read before any rule is recorded.
